name: EmlakX – Real Estate
author: emlakplatformllc

sections.description:
A powerful, high-performance real estate plugin connecting WordPress directly to the EmlakPlatform.com.tr API to showcase properties, projects, lands, and resales.

EmlakX – Real Estate provides a complete property management solution for agencies, brokers, and property developers. It seamlessly synchronizes listings from EmlakPlatform with blazing-fast AJAX search, custom Elementor widgets, multi-currency switching, and full multilingual support.

🚀 Key Features

  • Dedicated Real Estate Listings: Display comprehensive property pages for Projects, Lands, and Resales with custom permalink routing (/projects/, /lands/, /resales/).
  • Interactive AJAX Search & Filter: Cascading dynamic dropdowns (Country → City → Area), property types, and price range filters with instant results and no page reloads.
  • Elementor Pro & Free Compatibility: Includes custom PropertyGrid and UniversalFilter Elementor widgets for total drag-and-drop design freedom.
  • Multilingual Architecture: Built-in deep integration with WPML and Polylang, supporting localized URL prefixes (e.g., /{lang}/projects/) and automatic RTL styling for Arabic out of the box.
  • Smart Multi-Currency Switcher: Cookie-based live currency conversion with cache-busting DOM updates for international real estate buyers.
  • Automated XML Real Estate Sitemap: Dedicated standalone XML sitemap (/emlakx-sitemap.xml) for all active listings, ensuring fast and flawless indexing in Google Search Console without conflicting with Yoast or Rank Math.
  • Instant WhatsApp Lead Generation: Direct click-to-chat inquiry buttons prefilled with property title and reference details for rapid client conversion.
  • Developer Friendly & Theme Overrides: Easily customize templates by copying files from includes/Front/Templates/ to an emlakx/ folder within your active theme, following WooCommerce conventions.
  • High Performance & Intelligent Caching: 12-hour WordPress transient cache with automatic invalidation upon API updates to guarantee ultra-fast page speeds.
  • Mobile-First & Responsive Design: Crafted with modern Bootstrap 5.3 and touch-friendly Swiper 11 galleries for an exceptional user experience on any device.

💡 Why Choose EmlakX?

  1. Official EmlakPlatform Integration: Direct, reliable synchronization with EmlakPlatform.com.tr without messy CSV imports or manual data entry.
  2. Standalone or Elementor: Use with Elementor or standard WordPress shortcodes ([emlakx_projects], [emlakx_lands], [emlakx_resales], [emlakx_currency_switcher]) and native rewrite templates.
  3. Optimized for Search Engines: Clean semantic markup, OpenGraph tags, and a dedicated XML sitemap designed to maximize property visibility on Google.
  4. No External Script Bloat: All assets are locally bundled and selectively enqueued only where needed for maximum performance and GDPR compliance.

External services

This plugin connects to external services provided by EmlakPlatform to synchronize real estate properties, listings, and taxonomy data.

  • Service: EmlakPlatform REST API (https://www.emlakplatform.com.tr/api/v1/).
  • What data is sent: API Access Key (for authentication), requested language code (lang), user preferred currency (currency), and search query parameters (e.g., property type, country, city, area, price range). No personal identifying visitor data (PII) is transmitted to the external service.
  • Terms of Service: EmlakPlatform Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: EmlakPlatform Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/emlakx/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to EmlakX > General Settings in your WordPress admin dashboard and enter your API Base URL and Access Key.
  4. Click Verify API to confirm your connection status.
  5. Review the Setup Guide tab to verify that your listing pages (Projects, Lands, Resales) are configured and assigned.
sections.faq:
Does EmlakX require an API key?

Yes, EmlakX requires an API Base URL and Access Key from EmlakPlatform to fetch real-time property listings. Contact your EmlakPlatform account representative for credentials.

Is Elementor required to use EmlakX?

No, Elementor is completely optional. EmlakX includes native page templates and WordPress shortcodes. If Elementor is installed, dedicated drag-and-drop widgets become available in the editor.

Does EmlakX support multilingual websites?

Yes, EmlakX offers native integration with both WPML and Polylang, including language prefix URL routing (/{lang}/projects/) and automatic RTL stylesheet switching for languages such as Arabic.

Can I customize the listing and detail templates?

Yes. Just like WooCommerce, you can copy any template file from emlakx/includes/Front/Templates/ into an emlakx/ folder within your active theme or child theme to override it safely without losing changes during updates.

How does the multi-currency switcher work?

The currency preference is stored in a secure client cookie (emlakx_currency) and passed to the API on each request. The frontend dynamically swaps .emlakx-price elements using AJAX without requiring a full page reload.

How do I submit the XML sitemap to Google Search Console?

Navigate to EmlakX > Setup Guide, copy the standalone XML sitemap URL (yoursite.com/emlakx-sitemap.xml), and submit it in Google Search Console. It works alongside existing SEO plugins such as Yoast SEO and Rank Math without conflict.
